Name: (AT) Fern's Witchy-Gothic Add Ons
Author: fernwisp
Description:
Super quick edits to create a matching dog house/cat house and tractor + garage for witchy-gothic buildings.

[b][u]INSTALLATION[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]ensure you have both SMAPI and Alternative Textures installed
[*]download this mod and unzip it into your mods folder
[*]purchase the paint bucket and scissors from Robin in order to apply the textures from this mod (use the scissors for the tractor; use the paint bucket for everything else)
[/list]
[b][u]CREDITS[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]Ali Read[/url]﻿ for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/420]Witchy-Gothic Buildings[/url] mod, which this mod uses assets from
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]﻿ for the base tractor from their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]
[/list]
